# ELIPAN Group

> ELIPAN Group builds independent brands that make hard systems simpler. Each brand keeps its own name, look and audience. Underneath, they all share one standard: research first, purposeful design, secure by default, honest AI, and people decide. Founded by Marcos Cuellar in Chicago.

## Brands
- [NENEMI](https://www.mynenemi.com/): An ADHD workspace. Step away, come back, and see where you left off.
- [CUEPA for Work](https://www.makingcuepa.com/): Workflows and applied AI for small businesses.
- [CUEPA for You](https://you.makingcuepa.com/): One-on-one AI coaching for everyday life.
- [ŌLLIN OS/GO](https://www.ollinos.com/): Verified account signals for staffing sales. ŌLLIN GO, built in, turns them into outreach a person approves.

## How we work
- CHIMAL, our audit: every draft is checked four ways before it ships (cites its source, a second AI tries to break it, checked line by line, a person decides).
- Nothing is sent without a person's OK.

## Founder
- Marcos Cuellar, founder of ELIPAN Group, Chicago.
- Not an engineer. He learned and built everything while in the seat, doing the work.
- ŌLLIN OS/GO came from his years in staffing sales. NENEMI came from having ADHD and needing support no tool gave him.
- ELIPAN is named for his mother.
- Philosophy: will this tool, feature or button make someone more efficient, fulfilled or productive? If not, we don't take it on.
- Google AI certified; Google Cybersecurity and Google Cloud agentic AI in progress.
